(BY SHRI ZISHAN KHAN - ADVOCATE FOR THE RESPONDENT  COMPLAINANT)
 Th is application coming on for motion hearing this day  passed the following:
 ORDER Case diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.

The applicant has filed this first application u/S 439,
Cr.P.C for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested by Police Station Kotwali, District Ujjain (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.68/2024 registered in relation to the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2) (n), 377, 506 of IPC.

sentences.text: The case of the prosecution is that on 01.04.2024 the prosecutirx along with her son lodged an oral report at Police Station Kotwali to the effect that she is an house maker and resides at Ujjain.
The prosecutrix is having two son and one daughter.
On 24.03.2024 at around 08:00 PM she received a phone call from the applicant, who called her at Nagar Nigam Ujjain.
When she reached at Nagar Nigam Ujjain, the applicant took her to near old bus stand where the applicant committed rape upon her and also un-natural sex with her.
Thereafter case was registered against the applicant for the offences as aforesaid.
I t is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
The applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
FIR has been registered after a delay of nine days.

The prosecutrix is a major lady of 40 years and the place of the incident is a public place and the prosecutrix could had raised an alarm during the incident, if she would not had been a consenting party, if at all the incident is said to had been committed..
Not only this the prosecutrix's son is having a money dispute with the applicant due to which a false report appears to have been has been lodged against the applicant.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
The applicant is in custody since 02.04.2024 and the trial will take time to be concluded.
On that basis, learned counsel for the applicant prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
P e r contra, the application is opposed by the State Counsel and submitted that no case for grant of bail is made out in the matter.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the complainant brought to the notice of this Court IA No.
9092 of 2024, wherein the prosecutrix had no objection while granting bail to the applicant.
3 MCRC-23634-2024

After hearing the learned Counsel for the parties and going through the record, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.
1,00,000/- (Rs. One Lakh only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court.

This Order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant :-
1.

The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by them;
2. The applicant will cooperate in the investigation/Trial, as the case may be;

sentences.text: 5. The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and 6.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigation Officer, as the case may be.
A copy of this order be sent to the Court concerned for compliance.
C.c as per rules.
